project_context.client: Yue Fung Metal & Plastic Products Co. Ltd. (裕豐金屬塑料製品有限公司)
project_context.type: 3D Experience Marketing Site & Industrial Manufacturer Portfolio
project_context.vibe: Modern industrial vibe, premium industrial luxury, awwwards-level craft
project_context.primary_audience: B2B Automotive and Electronics Clients seeking advanced precision tooling and manufacturing

rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid dark backgrounds paired with frosted glass overlays.
Use Neon Cyan (#00F3FF) or Amber (#FFB000) exclusively for technical highlights, active states, and 3D mode toggles.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for components with text overlays; always use glassmorphism with blur and a minimal opacity solid color to ensure text legibility.

scale.labels: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-neon_cyan

rules: Bilingual integration: Subtly pair English headings with smaller Traditional Chinese text (e.g., as an overline or watermark).
Headings should feature extremely tight tracking and stark font-weight contrasts.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing & High Tension. Use 2-3x typical spacing between sections to let the 3D and typography breathe.

bento_grid.rules: Avoid perfectly symmetrical layouts. Use asymmetric row/col spans (col-span-1, col-span-2) for the metrics counters under the hero.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]' for cards, headers, and modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px metallic/solid inner stroke to ground UI components.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay (mix-blend-overlay with 5-10% opacity) on the main body to remove digital flatness.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: MUST use '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth, weighted momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Use framer-motion for large kinetic hero text with signature on-load masked line-by-line reveal.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards should trigger a subtle `-translate-y-1` shift and an inner glow effect (box-shadow or radial gradient).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Apply subtle framer-motion `useScroll` based Y-axis transformations to background elements and manifesto numbers.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: One slow, smooth editorial marquee displaying brand name and core values (uppercase, mono/serif mix). Use 'react-fast-marquee'.

3d_and_interactive.hero_scene: Photorealistic 3D BMW 4 Series Coupé G22 style (logo removed).
view_modes: Exploded View (Parts translating outward on Y/Z axes)
3d_and_interactive.controls: PresentationControls for smooth user rotation. Use Drei's <Environment preset='city'> or custom HDRI for metallic reflections.
3d_and_interactive.technical_integration: Overlay HTML UI (mode toggles) using Drei's <Html> or absolute positioned DOM elements over the canvas. Ensure canvas does not block scroll.

sections.header: Floating frosted-glass navigation bar. Must be fixed, z-[100], and never fully transparent. Bilingual brand name. 'Request Demo' CTA button.
sections.hero: Full viewport height minus header. Massive line-by-line masked reveal typography. The 3D car model takes center stage.
sections.statistics_bento: Directly under the hero. Bento layout containing animated metric counters (e.g., '40 YRS', '±0.001mm Tolerance', 'ISO 9001:2015', '10M+ Parts/Yr'). Use Framer Motion 'useInView' to trigger count-up.
sections.manifesto_vision: Numbered chapter '01'. Massive typography, high negative space, focusing on vision and identity.
sections.history: Numbered chapter '02'. '40 years of Manufacturing Pedigree'. Timeline layout with fading scroll reveals.
sections.capabilities_tabs: Numbered chapter '03'. Tabbed interactive section: Precision Mold Making, High-Tolerance Metal Stamping, 2K/Overmolding, Automated Assembly. Use Shadcn Tabs, styled with glassmorphism.
sections.vertically_integrated: Numbered chapter '04'. High-contrast layout demonstrating end-to-end power.
sections.tolerance_nightmare: Numbered chapter '05'. Problem/Solution feature section emphasizing micron-level precision solving industry 'Tolerance Nightmares'.
sections.rfq_modal: Triggered via 'Request Demo'. Shadcn Dialog. Includes Shadcn Form for spec selections (materials, tolerances) and a styled file upload dropzone preview.

component_guidelines.libraries: Shadcn UI (Dialog, Tabs, Form, Select, Input), Framer Motion, Lenis, React Three Fiber, Lucide React / Phosphor Icons.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp, geometric, or subtle pill-shaped. Dark mode buttons with subtle metallic borders. Primary CTA should have an amber or gold hover glow.
component_guidelines.tabs: Override standard Shadcn tabs to look like industrial tech selectors (sharp edges, active state has a neon cyan or gold bottom border).

hero_fallback.description: Abstract dark metallic texture, fallback for 3D loading states.

manufacturing_detail.description: Detailed close-up of machined metal components, used in the 'Tolerance Nightmare' or Capabilities sections.

precision_gears.description: Macro mechanical gears, ideal for 'Vertically Integrated Power' section.

instructions_to_main_agent.3d_implementation: For the 3D car, if a true G22 3D model isn't available, create an impressive procedural abstract automotive geometry or load a generic sports car GLTF using Drei's useGLTF. Implement the 4 view modes by swapping materials (MeshStandardMaterial, MeshBasicMaterial with wireframe={true}, MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission for X-Ray).
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Rely heavily on Tailwind CSS. Customize the Shadcn components to remove the generic 'Vercel' look and adopt the industrial glassmorphism aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements (tabs, modal triggers, 3D toggles, form submissions) MUST include robust `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='rfq-modal-trigger'`).

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this frontend highly creative, distinctive, and industrial.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (glass overlays over 3D canvases over dark textures).
Do NOT center align the entire app container.
No AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
